sources.snippet: The sensitivity coefficients of 𝑘 with respect to Σ and 𝛼, denoted as (𝑑 𝑘 / 𝑑 Σ) and (𝑑 𝑘 / 𝑑 𝛼) respectively, are calculated using the DOS method.
